description.value:
At the end of a short or long rest, you generate a protective energy barrier around yourself. It lasts until your next short or long rest and has hit points equal to twice your scout level plus your Intelligence modifier; its hit point maximum is capped at that same total.

Any damage you take is absorbed by the barrier first. Once the barrier's hit points reach 0, further damage carries through to you.

A depleted barrier can no longer absorb damage, but it isn't gone; casting a tech power of 1st level or higher restores hit points to it equal to the tech points you spent.

As long as the barrier still has hit points remaining, you also gain the following benefits:

  • You count as proficient in Constitution saving throws when maintaining concentration on tech powers.
  • Any hostile creature that hits you with a melee attack suffers energy damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).
